purpose: A CLI Linear Session from a records table whose rows place the records out of request order (OV-3775, OV-3313 review 3 H1): record 1 (TESTA) on row 2, record 2 (REGEX.1) at row 1 column 1, record 3 (FORCEDLBL) at row 1 column 2; the CLI draws REGEX.1 and FORCEDLBL on the first row and TESTA on the second
writer: gbdraw/linear.py --save_session (CLI sidecar), run from the fix/record-order-row-one-rule worktree on PYTHONPATH
command: PYTHONPATH=<worktree> python -c 'from gbdraw.cli import main; main()' linear --records_table rt.tsv --save_session -o cli-linear-records-table-grid
workingDirectory: a scratch folder; the inputs are tests/fixtures/b_collide.gb, tests/fixtures/regex_rules.gb and tests/fixtures/forced_label_underlay.gb
recordsTable: gbk	order	row	column / b_collide.gb	1	2	1 / regex_rules.gb	2	1	1 / forced_label_underlay.gb	3	1	2 (tab-separated, one line per slash)
